$comment: D-CSUBSET-NULLPTR-BOOL-CONVERSION (C 6.3.1.2): the scalar -> _Bool implicit assignment conversion. A scalar (arithmetic / pointer / nullptr) assigned to a _Bool yields 0 if it compares equal to 0 else 1 — realized by coerce() as the `!= 0` truthiness test (the same shape `if(x)` lowers), NOT a low-bit-truncating Cast (so `_Bool b = 2` is TRUE). Admitted at the semantic tier by isAssignable's scalarConvertsToBool arm. Closes the gap the D-CSUBSET-SIZEOF-COMPARISON-INT-TYPE fix unmasked (`_Bool b = (a<b)` — a comparison now types int). Rows: comparison->bool (true), nonzero-int->bool (true), zero->bool (false), 2->bool (TRUE — the low-bit-Trunc catch), non-null-ptr->bool (true), null-ptr->bool (false), nullptr->bool (false), plus two arithmetic round-trips of the stored 0/1 bytes -> 42. RED-ON-DISABLE: revert the isAssignable scalarConvertsToBool arm -> every `_Bool b = <scalar>` fails S0003 and the example does not compile. || P42 lane C — the THREE source categories the arm's first roster left out, each reaching the SAME `!= 0` chokepoint: a `_BitInt(N)` (C23 6.2.5 makes it an integer, hence arithmetic, hence scalar), an ARRAY (C 6.3.2.1p3 decays it to &a[0] first) and a FUNCTION DESIGNATOR (C 6.3.2.1p4 decays it to &fn first). Reference control, each probed SEPARATELY: clang 18.1.3 -std=c23 compiles and RUNS all three; gcc 13.3.0 -std=c2x runs the array and the designator and lacks _BitInt entirely (a missing FEATURE, not a rejection) — the bar's test is the DISJUNCTION, so all three are required. Each new row is chosen so a WRONG realization gives a DIFFERENT exit: `_BitInt` 2 has a ZERO LOW BIT (a low-bit Trunc says false), the 80-bit `_BitInt` holds 1<<70 so LIMB 0 IS ALL ZERO (a low-limb-only compare says false), and the array is ZERO-FILLED so a value-load of its first element says false where the decayed ADDRESS says true. All three are driven through all FOUR assignment-family positions (init / assign / call-arg / return), which are four callers of ONE isAssignable+coerce pair. RED-ON-DISABLE for the new half: remove the `isArithmetic(interner, rhs)` / `rk == TypeKind::FnSig` / Array disjuncts from the scalarConvertsToBool arm -> the _BitInt, array and designator rows fail S0003 and the example does not compile.
